eps.t: Something for Mom: Italy and France
eps.o: A mother's love is unconditional, and these travelers are heading to Italy and France in hopes of showing their gratitude.

eps.t: Songs in the Key of Wife in Estepona, Spain
eps.o: A flight attendant who's also a classical pianist looks to reconnect with her husband in Estepona, Spain. He's a music producer and prefers a quiet place to he creative, but she's strong-willed and wants to he immersed in the city's culture.

A jet-setting Seattle couple looks to hang up their wings and settle in Wellington, New Zealand. She wants a view close to a coffee shop while he wants access to hiking trails, but on one income, they may have to choose between cost and convenience.

A high-flying acrobat looks to move from New York for circus training in Melbourne, Australia. She's looking for a place on her own that's near school with plenty of room to trian, but on her tight budget, she may have to consider roommates.

eps.t: Old Town, New Life in Pieve di Teco, Italy
eps.o: After becoming single, a mother of two looks to reinvent herself in Pieve di Teco, Italy. She's built a community for an easier transition for her son, but with her daughter in college, finding a place with enough guest space may be a challenge.

Seizing a new job opportunity, a single woman takes a leap of faith and moves from Dallas to Amsterdam. She's looking for a place near the city center, but in an extremely difficult housing market, she may have to make a few compromises.

After a decade in New York City, a breakup leads a woman to relocate to Madrid. She has a friend along to help in the search, and she wants a place near the city center, but she may have to compromise between price and location.

eps.t: Trading Freeways for a Fresh Start in Valencia
eps.o: After years of chasing the American dream in California, a couple reset their lives in Valencia, Spain. They're looking for Spanish charm with modern amenities, but finding the right place that's in their budget may be a challenge.

eps.t: A Family Reinvention in Porto, Portugal
eps.o: A Texas family looks to reinvent their lives with a move to Porto, Portugal. They're looking for a place that prioritizes their tween daughter's need, and he prefers something modern and affordable, but she wants Portuguese charm at any cost.
